{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Mission Parameters

|serverExec= server

|descr= Sets overcast using [[BIS_fnc_setOvercast]].

|s1= [0] call [[BIS_fnc_paramWeather]]

|r1= [[Number]] - overcast value (ranging from 0 to 1).
